Zombie apocalypse at a theme park. Part two.
The wheel is moving. Nora's cabin is going down.
In the control booth, someone is leaning on the lever.
But he isn't driving. He's infected. He just fell on it.
Three minutes until her cabin reaches the ground.
Then the radio again. It's Gus, the night mechanic, hiding in the generator shed.
He says, the cabins go down. The hub doesn't.
Rule number two. Find the part that stays still.
Every spoke has a service ladder. Nora zips Pickles into her jacket, and climbs.
One hundred feet up, at the hub, she stops moving. The wheel turns around her.
But the lights are still calling every infected in the park.
Rule number three. Move the noise.
Gus starts the roller coaster. Empty train. Loudest chain in the county.
Every head turns. Away from her.
It works. Until the train comes back.
And at the station, the lap bars unlock by themselves.
